headline: Sensex drops 330 points, snapping four-day winning streak as IT stocks drag; Adani companies settle with Sebi

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: IT stocks dragged the market lower during the trading session
The Nifty 50 snapped a four-day winning streak, closing below 23,350
Mixed global cues and profit booking influenced investor sentiment
Initial gains from crude oil price corrections were lost by the market close
whatHappening: Five Adani group companies settled disclosure violation cases with Sebi for ₹1.51 crore
JSW’s Ampstar is investing ₹2,500 crore into the electric commercial vehicle sector
Persistent Systems' arm raised its stake in Nagarro to 83.25% with plans to delist it
Wipro partnered with Oracle Life Sciences for cloud-based drug safety operations
summary: Indian markets ended lower as the Sensex fell 330 points, ending a four-day winning streak led by a decline in IT stocks. Despite a positive start fueled by crude oil corrections and strong US tech leads, domestic indices failed to sustain momentum. Key corporate actions included Adani group settlements and significant expansion moves by JSW and Persistent Systems.
